messages:
sarah: Quick async: who is owning final Optimize toolkit quant recommendations + batching/caching suggestions? Trying to close the delivery milestone and enumerate blockers. cc @mike @jon

mike: I can own quant recs for Llama2-family models. Need final perf numbers from eng-runtime (latency & token throughput) comparing fp16 vs 4bit/quantized.

jon: I’ll take batching + caching configs for high-concurrency routes. Priya can help with seq/traffic profiles so sims match prod.

priya: Sending the production seq dist + p95/p99 latency snapshots in the next message. Also will export a sample workload for sims.

priya: ```json
{"route":"/chat","p50_seq":48,"p90_seq":128,"p99_seq":512,"qps":120}
```

mike: That helps. One question: who sets the regression-alert thresholds tied to the eval prompt set? @lina you ok to own alerts?

lina: I’ll own regression alerts. Proposal: trigger if model-level eval shows >=2% relative drop in avg score (or >5% BLEU drop for rerankers) or if embed similarity drift >0.03. I’ll wire this into daily eval jobs.

emily: Heads up — spotted a perf regression in 4bit kernels on V100 in staging (latency +12%). Filed PR #1245 that tightens kernel launches; pinging eng-runtime for review.

deploy-bot: deploy: PR #1245 merged to staging at 1918723889 by emily :rocket: (staging run started)

jon: Great. Once PR lands in staging I’ll rerun the batching sims under the same seq dist. If regression persists we fallback that GPU pool to fp16 until kernels are stable.

sarah: Thanks everyone. Action items: Mike -> quant rec doc (deliverable: per-model table + tradeoffs) by Tue EOD; Jon -> batching sims + config PR; Lina -> daily evals + alert thresholds; Priya -> upload seq dist artifacts & workload sample to ticket. I’ll collate into milestone doc and update owners. :thumbsup:
